preconditions.description: The number of olympiads before the rule was introduced, the number of cities, and the number of years of interest are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= m for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each host city in the first n olympiads is within the range of available cities.

preconditions.expression: all(n + 1 <= k_i <= 10**18 for k_i in k)
preconditions.description: Each year of interest is within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The number of output cities matches the number of years of interest.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= city <= m for city in result)
postconditions.description: Each output city is within the range of available cities.

postconditions.expression: all(host_city_counts[city] == host_city_counts[city] for city in set(a))
postconditions.description: The host city counts for cities that have already hosted are correctly maintained.

postconditions.expression: all(host_city_counts[city] == 0 for city in set(range(1, m+1)) - set(a))
postconditions.description: The host city counts for cities that have not yet hosted are initialized to zero.

postconditions.expression: all(next_host_city(k_i) == result[i] for i, k_i in enumerate(k))
postconditions.description: The host city for each year of interest is correctly determined according to the rule.

invariants.expression: all(host_city_counts[city] >= 0 for city in range(1, m+1))
invariants.description: The host city counts are non-negative.
The total number of host city occurrences matches the number of olympiads before the rule was introduced.
